transcript.title: The Dino Team by the Sea
transcript.text:
Maya reads about dinosaurs each day.

She reads that a big dino had a long neck. It ate leaves from the treetops. Its feet were the size of a road sign!

Today Maya has a dream. She is on a boat at sea. A dino swims by. It has a green tail and a wide, flat snout.

"Wait for me!" Maya calls.

The dino leads the boat to a beach. On the sand, three baby dinos peep and squeak. They need a meal.

Maya lays out a pile of leaves. Each baby eats and eats. Then they nap in the heat.

A big dino roars. It is not mean. It is a thank-you roar!

Maya waves. "See you soon, dino team!"

Then she wakes up. Her book is on her lap.

"Dinosaurs are real," Maya says. "They lived long ago. And I can read all about them!"
transcript.cover_scene: A girl in a small boat near a sunny beach waves at a friendly green long-necked dinosaur while three baby dinosaurs peek from the sand.

chapters.title: The Dino Team by the Sea
chapters.text:
Maya sees a dino team by the sea.

Big Rex eats meat. He has a loud roar. Little Pea eats leaves and beans. She is neat and sweet.

"Let's go!" says Pea. The team takes a trail.

Rain drops fall. Drip, drip! The trail is wet. Pea will not wail. She can wait.

Rex sees a boat. The boat can float! The team gets on. They sail on the sea.

A seal peeks up. "Meet my team!" says the seal. The seal eats fish.

The sun heats the day. The team naps in the heat.

Back home, Maya reads a book about dinosaurs. Real scientists dig up dino bones and teach us cool facts each year!

Maya can read each word: sea, team, rain, trail, boat, float.

Two letters, one sound! Maya is a reading star.
chapters.cover_scene: A small green dinosaur and a big friendly red dinosaur ride a wooden boat on a sunny blue sea while a seal peeks out of the water.

transcript.title: The Dino Train on Rain Road
transcript.text:
Maya reads a fact: scientists still find new dinosaurs each year!

Today Maya plays dino train. Her train goes down Rain Road.

Toot! Toot! A dino waits by the road. It has a long tail and big toes.

"Climb in!" Maya calls. "Do not be afraid."

The dino climbs in. Rain falls on the train. The road is wet.

Soon they meet a goat. The goat has a coat of white hair.

"May I ride?" says the goat.

"Wait for us!" peep three small dinos.

They all sail down Rain Road. The train goes past a boat. It goes past a beach. It goes past a big oak tree.

At last the rain stops. The sun is bright.

Maya hands out a meal. Green leaves for the dinos. Oats for the goat. Toast for Maya.

"This is real fun," says Maya.

The dino gives a loud roar. It means thank you!
transcript.cover_scene: A girl drives a bright toy-like train down a rainy road with a long-tailed dinosaur, three baby dinosaurs, and a white goat riding along.

chapters.title: The Dino Team by the Sea
chapters.text:
Maya loves dinosaurs. Today she reads a new book.

A big dino goes down to the sea. Her name is Bea. She eats green leaves all day. Munch, munch!

Bea sees a boat. Two small dinos sail on it. They wave at Bea.

"Come play!" they squeak. "We seek a big bone in the sand!"

Bea walks on the beach. Her big feet leave deep tracks. She digs with her snout.

Wait! She feels a bone. It is real! The team cheers.

"That bone is from a dino long ago," Maya reads. "Scientists dig up bones and teach us the facts."

Bea nods at the sea. The sun is low. It is time to go.

The three dinos eat leaves and dream of more bones.

Maya shuts her book. She can dig too. She can read too. Dinosaurs are the best!

Maya takes her pail and a coat. The trail goes up a hill to a dark cave.

"Wait," says Maya. "I see something!"

A big bone sits in the coal. It is as long as an oar.

Maya digs. She digs by the goat trail. She digs in the rain. Her nails get black.

Then — a huge dino skull! It has teeth like nails.

"I will call it Roar Toe," says Maya. She paints the name on a sign.

Maya loads the bones on a cart. The cart rolls down the road. A goat trails her all the way.

At home, Maya lays each bone on a mat. She soaks them clean.

chapters.title: The Dino Team by the Sea
chapters.text:
Meet the dino team!

Rain fell on the green trail. A big dino ate leaves. Her name was Bean.

Bean had a goal. She had to reach the sea.

Her pal Toad ran on the road. "Wait for me!" he said.

They ran past a tall oak. They ate a snack of seeds. Bean took a deep breath.

Soon they could see the sea! Waves ran up the sand. A boat sailed by.

Bean and Toad played all day. They made a big dino road in the sand.

Then they ate a meal of green leaves and beans.

"This day was neat," said Toad.

Scientists still read about dinos and find new facts each year. They dig up bones and paint art of dino teams like Bean and Toad.

Maybe you will read a new dino fact today!

transcript.title: Maya Draws a Dinosaur
transcript.text:
At the museum, kids can learn to draw a dinosaur. Maya wants to try.

She gets a sheet of paper and a black pen.

"Start with the main shape," says the guide.

Maya draws a big round body. Then she draws a long neck that reaches up high.

Next, the tail. It sweeps out like a road.

The feet need three toes each. Maya counts them. One, two, three!

Now the head. Two eyes. A wide jaw. Teeth like green leaves.

"What did it eat?" Maya asks.

"It ate plants," says the guide. "Leaves, seeds, and reeds by the stream."

So Maya draws a stream. She draws an oak tree. She paints the dino brown and gray.

She writes the name in neat letters.

The guide smiles. "That is a great dinosaur!"

Maya beams. She takes her drawing home and tapes it by her bed.

chapters.title: The Dino Team by the Sea
chapters.text:
A big green dino likes the sea.

Her name is Bean. Bean is on a team.

The team can dig. The team can read.

Today they seek a dino bone by the sea.

Bean sees a toad on a road. "Hi, toad!" says Bean.

The toad hops to the beach. Bean leads the team.

They dig in the sand. They dig deep.

A big bone! The team can see it!

Bean sees a green leaf on the bone.

"This bone is old," says Bean. "Real old!"

The team sails the bone home in a boat.

Scientists read bones like this. They learn how dinos ate and ran.

Bean eats a meal of leaves. The team eats too.

The toad eats a bean!

Bean dreams of the sea, the toad, the road, and the big bone.

Bean and the team will seek more bones. Soon!

chapters.title: Toad the Dino Meets the Sea
chapters.text:
Toad is a green dino. Toad has a pal named Bean.

Today Toad and Bean go to the sea.

"The sea is deep," says Bean. "The sea is neat!"

Toad sees a boat. The boat can float! Toad and Bean leap in the boat.

The boat goes past the reef. Toad sees a big seal eat a fish.

"Eat, seal, eat!" says Bean.

Then Toad sees a tail in the sea. It is not a seal. It is a sea dino!

"Do not be afraid," says Bean. "The sea dino eats fish, not us."

Toad waves. The sea dino waves back.

On the beach, Toad and Bean read a book about dinosaurs. The book has real facts and art. Scientists still dig up new dinosaurs today!

"I wish I had a big tail," says Bean.

"You do!" says Toad.

Bean and Toad laugh by the sea.

transcript.text:

Maya runs down the trail. A tail swishes by her feet. It is a play dino tail!

She jumps over a pretend road. She dodges a big oak tree.

Maya leaps on a pretend boat. She sails past the beach. She sees a goat on a rock.

"Dino coming!" calls Miss Jean.

chapters.title: Dino Team by the Sea
chapters.text:
Meet the dino team. Jean is a big green dino. Toad is a small oak-brown dino.

Jean and Toad play by the sea.

"I see a boat!" said Jean.
"I see a road!" said Toad.

Jean eats leaves. Toad eats beans. They eat by the sea all day.

A wave soaks Toad. Toad gets wet feet!
Jean lets out a squeak. Then they both beam.

Soon the sun goes down. The sea is calm.
"Let's go home," said Jean.
Toad and Jean take the road home.

At home, they read a book. The book tells real dino facts! It says a dino can be as big as a boat. It says some dino feet made deep tracks in mud long ago. Scientists find them today!

Jean and Toad read it each day.
"Read it again!" said Toad.
So Jean did.
